Privacy Policy

Last updated November 26, 2026

Overview

Epoch Tasks ("the app") is a personal task-tracking app provided by its developer ("we", "us"). This policy explains what information the app handles, where it is stored, and what the third-party services the app uses may collect.

In short: what you create in Epoch Tasks stays on your device unless you choose to turn on Cloud Sync or connect an AI assistant. Both are optional; if you use them, your tasks are stored in your private account so they can sync between your devices and be reached by the assistants you allow. We never sell your information or use it for advertising.

Information you create

Tasks, tags, notes, due dates and times (including the time zone a task was created in), notification settings, app settings, and any photos or files you attach are stored on your device, inside the app's private storage. Attached photos and files are copies of items you choose yourself through the system picker; to keep them small (100 KB at most), photos are re-compressed on your device when you attach them.

If you don't use Cloud Sync, this information never leaves your device: we cannot see, access, back up or recover it, and uninstalling the app or clearing its data deletes it.

Settings → Export Data lets you save your own backup file, and Import Data restores from one. Where you store an exported file (for example a cloud drive) is your choice and governed by that service's terms.

Cloud Sync (optional)

Cloud Sync lets you back up your tasks and keep them the same on all your devices. It is off until you sign in (Settings → Cloud Sync) with Google, or with Apple on iPhone.

When you sign in, we receive from Google or Apple an account identifier and, if you allow it, your name and email address; Google also gives us the web address of your profile picture. While you are signed in, your tasks, tags, notes, due dates and times, time zones, notification settings and attached photos and files are stored in your account, along with your device's time zone, so they appear on your other signed-in devices. Attached files are limited to 100 KB each and 5 MB per account; when you remove a file from all your tasks, the app deletes it from your account, usually within a few days.

This data is stored and processed for us by Google Firebase (Firebase Authentication, Cloud Firestore and Cloud Storage, operated by Google LLC), currently in the United States. It is used only to provide Cloud Sync and the AI-assistant connection described below. We don't look at your tasks except where needed to keep the service running, to respond to a request from you, or where required by law. Your synced data is kept until you delete it or your account.

Like any online service, our servers (Google Cloud) automatically log technical details of each request — such as its time, your IP address and any error — which we use only to keep the service secure and to fix problems. These logs are deleted automatically within 30 days.

Signing out stops syncing; you choose whether your tasks stay on the device or are removed from it (they stay in your account either way). Tasks kept on a device stay yours: they are never added to another account that signs in on it. Settings → Cloud Sync → Delete Account permanently deletes your synced data, your AI-assistant connections and links, and your sign-in from our systems right away; the tasks on your device stay. We keep only the deleted account's random identifier and the date, without your name, email address or any tasks, so that a device or assistant that was still signed in can't bring the account back. Copies in Google's internal backups are removed on Google's regular schedule. If you no longer have the app, you can ask us to delete your account: https://epochtasks.app/delete-account.html

AI assistants (optional)

You can connect an AI assistant — such as Claude (Anthropic), ChatGPT (OpenAI) or Gemini (Google) — to your Epoch Tasks account in two ways: by signing in with Google on our page (connect.epochtasks.app) when the assistant asks and tapping Allow, or, for assistants that can't sign in, with a personal link you create in Settings → Connect an AI Assistant. The assistant can then read, add, change and delete your tasks when you ask it to. It can't delete your account.

If you sign in this way with a Google account that doesn't have an Epoch Tasks account yet, one is created, even if you don't use the app. What we receive from Google, and how the tasks are stored and processed, is the same as described under Cloud Sync. The page loads Google's sign-in code and keeps you signed in on that browser until you switch accounts or clear the site's data.

For each assistant that signs in we store its name, the site or app it connects from, what it may do, when it was connected and last used, and only fingerprints of the access codes it uses (not the codes themselves). Temporary sign-in records expire within an hour, and an assistant that hasn't been used for 90 days loses access; both are then deleted automatically, usually within a day or so. For each personal link we store only a fingerprint of it (not the link itself), the name you see in the app, and when it was created and last used.

Settings → Connect an AI Assistant lists your assistants and links. You can disconnect an assistant or turn off a link there at any time, and it stops working immediately. Anyone who has a personal link can access your tasks, so keep it private.

What you share with an assistant, and what it does with your tasks, is governed by that assistant's own terms and privacy policy; we don't control it.

Voice assistants (optional)

You can add a task by voice — with Siri on iPhone, or, where Google makes it available, Gemini on Android. Your voice is processed by Apple or Google under their own privacy policies; we never receive audio. The app receives only the task itself (its title and, if you said them, a due date, time and notes), which is saved in the app's private storage on your device and added to your list the next time you open the app. Like any task, it is synced only if you use Cloud Sync.

Device backup

If you have turned on your device's backup — Android backup to your Google account, or iCloud Backup on iPhone — the operating system may include the app's data in that backup and restore it when you reinstall the app or set up a new device. This is a feature of Android or iOS, operated by Google or Apple under your account settings — we never receive that data. You can turn device backup off in your device settings.

Notifications

If you add notifications to a task, or keep the daily summary on (a 9:00 AM notification listing what's due), the app schedules them locally on your device using the device's own (Android or iOS) notification system. No notification data is sent to us or to any server. You can turn the daily summary off in Settings, and all notifications off in your device settings.

Permissions the app uses

On Android: Notifications — to show the task reminders you add. Alarms & reminders (exact alarms) — so reminders can fire on time; if you don't allow it, Android may deliver them later. Run at startup and keep awake — so scheduled reminders are restored after your phone restarts and are delivered while it's asleep. Vibration — for haptic feedback.

On iPhone: Notifications — to show the task reminders you add. Allow Tracking (App Tracking Transparency) — asked only for advertising, as described below; the app works the same whichever you choose.

Photos and files — only the specific items you choose in the system picker; the app has no general access to your photos or files.

Internet and network state — used by the advertising and in-app purchase services described below, and, only if you sign in, by Cloud Sync. Without Cloud Sync, the app never sends your task data over the network.

Advertising

The free version of Epoch Tasks may show ads served by Google AdMob. To serve and measure ads, Google and its partners may collect your device's advertising ID (on iPhone, only if you allow tracking when asked), general device and app information, your IP address (used to estimate approximate location), and ad interaction data.

Where required by law — including for users in the EEA, UK and Switzerland — the app asks for your consent before personalized ads are shown; if you decline, non-personalized ads are shown. You can change that choice at any time in Settings → Ad Privacy Choices, and reset your advertising ID or opt out of ad personalization in your device settings (on iPhone: Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking).

Google's use of this data is governed by Google's own policies: https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites

In-app purchase

The optional one-time "Remove Ads" purchase is processed entirely by the store you installed the app from — Google Play or Apple's App Store. We never receive or store your payment details; the store tells the app only whether the purchase is valid.

What we don't do

We don't require an account — Cloud Sync is optional. We don't collect your contacts or location, files only reach us if you attach them to a task while signed in to Cloud Sync, and we only receive your name, email address and profile picture address if you sign in to Cloud Sync or to connect an AI assistant. We don't sell your personal information, we don't use it for advertising, and we don't use analytics or tracking of our own.

Security

On your device, your data is protected by the device's own security (screen lock, encryption). If you use Cloud Sync, your data is sent over encrypted connections, encrypted at rest by Google, and accessible only to your signed-in account, the AI assistants you allow and the personal links you create, apart from the limited access described under Cloud Sync. No method of transmission or storage is perfectly secure, and keeping your device, your account and your links secure is your responsibility.

Children

Epoch Tasks is not directed at children under 13 (or the minimum age required in your country), and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

Your rights

If you don't use Cloud Sync and haven't connected an AI assistant, we hold no personal data about you — your data is on your device and under your control (export it, edit it, or delete it by clearing the app's data or uninstalling). If you use Cloud Sync, you can see and change your synced data in the app, export it with Settings → Export Data, and delete it at any time with Delete Account. If you only connected an assistant, sign in to Cloud Sync in the app with the same Google account to do the same, or email us. You can also contact us to request access or deletion (https://epochtasks.app/delete-account.html explains how). For data collected by Google for advertising, or by Google or Apple for purchases, use your Google or Apple account and device settings, or contact them. Depending on where you live (for example under the GDPR or California law) you may have additional rights; you can contact us with any privacy question.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy as the app changes. The date at the top will change, and if a change is material we'll tell you in the app the next time you open it.
